History.ArchiveHelp: Click to expand or collapse this compressed history block. Its undo states are retained.
History.CompressionHelp: Keep the latest 200 states ready for editing. Older uninterrupted history is compressed in blocks of 200. Click an archive in History to expand it.
History.LimitHelp: A finite limit shortens the history written to a project, including old intermediate states and branches. The open document retains its history until closed. The default is unlimited.
History.InvalidLimit: Enter a history limit between 1 and 1000000.
